purpose: Map the smallest repository surfaces required to admit an agent by demonstrated proof discipline, select a safe execution lane, validate the decision, produce local artifacts, and hand off without trusting model prose as proof.

directories.purpose: Agent admission, proof-reduction, routing, artifact, workflow, schema, and fixture contracts.
Scoped procedure for selecting a lane from deterministic admission evidence.
Opt-in local validation hooks; never installed implicitly.
Dependency-free structural and semantic contract tests.
English operator status, known gaps, traps, artifact policy, and proof ceiling.

commands.name: Admission harness completeness
commands.proof: tracked component, routing, fixture, and proof-reducer consistency

knownTraps: Agent presence, command availability, reputation, price, or prior success does not establish runtime-proof eligibility.
A lower-proof lane may not be reported as completion when the task requires live-runtime proof.
Not attempted, command acknowledged, launcher observed, runtime attached, and behavior observed are distinct proof states.
Stale evidence from another run, agent, provider, model, branch, commit, environment, or correlation ID must not promote proof.
Requested routing is not execution proof; record the actual executor, provider, model, lane, branch, and validation result.
Unknown or failed admission defaults to static/build-safe work only; live-runtime certification fails closed.
Generated admission evidence remains local-operational and untracked.
proofCeiling: Repository map and deterministic offline admission/routing contracts only; no provider call, model-quality judgment, runtime enforcement, external target behavior, or live certification proof.
